biggest_catch: New customers only: anyone who has owned a SouthState personal checking account in the past 12 months — or who previously received a SouthState checking bonus — is ineligible.
catches: Eligibility: at account opening, the customer cannot be a current owner or joint owner of a SouthState personal checking account, nor have been an owner/joint owner in the past 12 months.
Not available if any primary or joint owner(s) previously received a bonus on an eligible SouthState personal checking account.

Within 60 calendar days of opening, the account must have: (1) 15+ posted and cleared debit card purchases/payments, AND (2) cumulative direct deposits of at least $250 (salary, pension, Social Security, or other regular recurring income) OR $25+ in preauthorized automatic drafts by a third party using the routing/account number.

Internal account transfers, mobile deposits, debit card deposits, P2P transfers, instant payments, and branch/ATM deposits do NOT qualify as direct deposits; recurring debit-card payments, P2P transfers, and instant payments do NOT qualify as preauthorized automatic drafts.
SouthState Checking carries a $5 monthly maintenance charge unless enrolled in eStatements; a $25 minimum deposit is required to open in a branch (no minimum to open online).
Promo code 300BONUS must be used at opening; excludes the SouthState at Work product type.
Bonus cannot be combined with any other checking or deposit offer; SouthState may modify or discontinue the offer at any time without notice.
Residency restrictions may apply; not available to SouthState Bank employees.
Account must be open with no product-type change at the time of payment.
The bonus will be reported to the appropriate taxing authorities, as required by law or regulation.

c4.evidence: Offer is public on southstatebank.com — no login or targeted invite; anyone meeting the new-customer criteria can open with the public 300BONUS code.

steps: Open a new SouthState personal checking account online (no minimum deposit) or in a branch ($25 minimum deposit) using promo code 300BONUS during the promotional period.
Within 60 calendar days of opening, make 15+ posted and cleared debit card purchases/payments from the account.

Within the same 60 days, receive cumulative direct deposits totaling at least $250 (salary, pension, Social Security, or other regular recurring income) — OR set up $25+ in preauthorized automatic drafts by a third party using the bank's routing number and your account number.
Keep the account open with no product-type change; the $300 bonus posts within 2 business days of the 60-day qualifying period.
Expect the bonus to be reported to taxing authorities as required by law.
timing: Qualifying activity window is 60 calendar days from account opening. Bonus posts within 2 business days after the 60-day qualifying period. Official page references a defined promotional period; aggregators report it ending 9/30/2026.
